sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle with completed UChicago mathematics bachelor’s. Mathematics expects a recent
mathematics degree or equivalent preparation and GPA >=3.00 in the last 60 credits; central policy also states
3.00 overall. Your grades are not supplied. F-1/J-1 applicants cannot use Mason’s provisional or conditional
admission routes to remedy deficient entry standards. This is an institution-specific restriction, not a claim
about all US universities. [s5] [s10]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the mathematics PhD application; arrange three references and a goals statement. Resolve the
in-progress-degree English exemption before submission. If any transcripts are from outside the US, Mason
offers its own evaluation and recommends applying six weeks early; a UChicago-only academic record is a US
record. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
A prior faculty agreement is not listed as an admission condition. Direct research-fit enquiries may be useful;
funding nomination can require a mentor commitment. Use gradmath@gmu.edu for requirements. Faculty
below are a targeted fit list, not a promise they will take a fall 2027 student. [s4] [s5] [s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
The current central program record supplies the application link and dates. Authenticated form fields were not
inspected; no account was created and no referee invitations were sent. [s1]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Central admissions has explicit fall 2027 dates; catalog is 2026-27. Most department and funding pages are
standing/undated and some contradict central instructions. [s1] [s2] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Without exemption: IELTS 7.0, each component >=6.5; TOEFL taken from January 21, 2026: 5.0 overall and 4.5
each subsection (older test: 88/20); DET 120 or PTE 67. Scores valid two years. TOEFL code 5827; Home
Edition/MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake accepted; IELTS Indicator rejected. [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
A completed degree from a recognized US institution qualifies for the published degree waiver. Thus a
completed UChicago bachelor’s meets this route; the page does not explicitly extend it to an unfinished degree
at application time. International TA assessment is separate: current hiring instructions require CELTD even
after an admission waiver, whereas the appointments policy has narrower wording. Confirm the assessment in
the funding offer. [s6] [s11] [s12]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; a departmental degree page additionally recommends it. These statements can coexist: optional
but recommended is more precise than “not considered.” Portal acceptance/weight not explicitly established.
[s3] [s5]

Recommended for pure mathematics applicants by the departmental degree page; not an admission
requirement under the catalog’s GRE policy. [s3] [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department advertises USD 27,000 annual stipend, tuition waiver and graduate health insurance; the same
page calls support academic-year funding. Exact 2027 rate, number of paid months, mandatory-fee coverage
and net amount are not stated. First-summer research support is advertised as guaranteed, without a dollar
amount. Presidential Scholarship: USD 36,000/12 months, 18 fall/spring tuition credits, mandatory student fee
and subsidized insurance; no summer tuition, new-student/course/lab fees. [s2] [s13]
Years of support [Standing rule]
No universal mathematics multi-year guarantee found. Presidential support renews annually for up to four
years. [s2] [s13]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students can hold assistantships subject to enrollment/work authorization and teaching-language
rules. Presidential guidance explicitly contemplates international recipients. Fall 2027 Inclusion and Access
scholarship excludes holders/intended holders of F-1/J-1 and other nonimmigrant visas. [s12] [s13] [s14]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Assistantships require full-time enrollment, good standing and at least 3.0 GPA. F-1 employment is limited to
20 hours/week during term under Mason guidance. CELTD may be required despite the US-degree admission
waiver. Presidential renewal requires 3.5 graduate GPA, continuing progress and program support; award is
research work, normally 20 hours/week. [s11] [s12] [s13]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Presidential Scholarship: department nomination, mentor commitment, normally >=3.5 prior-degree GPA; no
applicant self-nomination. Standard math assistantship separate form not identified publicly; ask when
completing the academic application. [s13] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
College lists Clarke Family mathematics award (currently closed) and Feinstein mathematics award (spring).
Becker environmental-research funding is available later to eligible enrolled students. No 2027 amounts or
open dates for these math awards are verified; they are not substitutes for an admission funding offer. [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 75, nonrefundable. [s7]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
Math FAQ limits waivers to existing College of Science PhD students switching into math, which does not cover
this applicant. College pages separately advertise a workforce-disruption waiver; central application page
dates that initiative to fall 2025. No applicable fall 2027 need-based international waiver was established.
Confirm with the department before payment. [s4] [s7] [s9]
